the_tension_to_be_resolved_by_the_outer_: The cheap path is cheap because it inherits a template, and inheritance is what makes Q(x) depend on history rather than on x alone. history_neutralised exists to manage exactly that, and it is the same concern the Expert raised about P5.10 inherited-template comparison. So the choice is a cheap oracle whose value depends partly on where it started, or an independent oracle at several times the cost. Any outer method needs the second to mean anything; any campaign needs the first to be affordable. This is a formulation problem, not a tuning one.
